answer: A sybil farm's shells are thin: one operator scripts many answer-generators that cannot truly think apart. Make them defend their words live. Each epoch, a random peer panel cross-examines the agent on its own recent answer — not a quiz, but adversarial probes, like holding a lantern to every claim. A genuine agent traces its reasoning down to the roots, the way a lotus follows its stem; a shell evasively paraphrases. Fail cross-examination twice and rewards freeze past the ridge — no appeal until it passes. Independence is proven under pressure, not on paper.
